description: This file defines a WebSocket connection manager class for handling real-time messaging and notifications, including methods for connecting, disconnecting, sending messages to specific users, and broadcasting messages to all active connections.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Handles active WebSocket connections for real-time communication, managing connection registration, removal, messaging to individual users, and broadcasting to all connected clients.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the ConnectionManager with an empty connection mapping and an asyncio lock for concurrency control.

methods.name: None connect(self, user_id: int, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Accepts a WebSocket connection and registers it for the specified user ID.

methods.name: None disconnect(self, user_id: int, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket connection for a given user ID and cleans up if no connections remain.

methods.name: None send_to_user(self, user_id: int, payload: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Sends a JSON payload to all active WebSocket connections of a specific user.

methods.name: None broadcast(self, payload: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Sends a JSON payload to all active WebSocket connections across all users.

ctags.name: broadcast
ctags.pattern: /^    async def broadcast(self, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:$/

ctags.name: connect
ctags.pattern: /^    async def connect(self, user_id: int, websocket: WebSocket) -> None:$/

ctags.name: disconnect
ctags.pattern: /^    async def disconnect(self, user_id: int, websocket: WebSocket) -> None:$/

ctags.name: send_to_user
ctags.pattern: /^    async def send_to_user(self, user_id: int, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:$/
